pages.text: The guide records what the Charter has learned. Blood belongs in the field assay kit.
pages.title: Blood assay
A sealed answer
pages.text: Craft the kit with a glass bottle, iron ingot, copper ingot and assimilation essence. Sneak-use it to draw a nonlethal sample costing one heart.

pages.title: A sealed answer
pages.text: Use normally to inspect the sealed sample: patient, infection percentage, stage and sample age. It is a measured snapshot; draw another sample to check your recovery.

pages.title: Leave before it answers
pages.text: Live hearts can build infection while you stay nearby. The effects intensify by stage; extreme exposure has consequences beyond a passing sickness.

pages.title: Leave before it answers
pages.text: Low exposure subsides away from the source. Check a fresh assay before another long harvest. Assimilation Disruption blocks new exposure. A Disruption Charm supplies it while held in the offhand or worn in a Curios charm slot; an

pages.title: Leave before it answers
pages.text: existing dose still needs time to subside.

pages.title: Leave before it answers
pages.text: The kit remembers its sealed sample. The journal retains only your discoveries.
The journal teaches the assay; the kit holds the blood and measured result.
